Tours will start at LaunchPoint (ITLL 110, next to the 3D Printers on the south end of the building). Tours are free and will last roughly 30 minutes. Please bring your Buff OneCard, as it is required for the tour. 

After completing the ITLL Orientation Tour you will have access to the following:

  • Buff OneCard access to the ITL Laboratory during ITLL extended card access hours,
  • Use of on-site ITLL computers,
  • ITLP cloud-based virtual computers,
  • Sign up for and participate in ITLP Skill Building Workshops, and
  • Check out an extensive list of equipment, tools, and supplies for coursework
